description: This file defines a PHP trait RetryHelperTrait within the Aws\Retry namespace. It provides helper methods for retry logic, including adding retry headers to requests, updating retry statistics, and binding statistics back to results or exceptions.

classes.name: RetryHelperTrait
classes.description: A PHP trait providing helper methods for retry management in AWS SDK requests.

methods.name: addRetryHeader
methods.description: Adds a retry header to the request indicating the number of retries and delay.

methods.name: updateStats
methods.description: Updates the total retry delay and retries attempted count in the stats array.

methods.name: updateHttpStats
methods.description: Updates HTTP transfer statistics in the stats array based on an exception or result object.

methods.name: bindStatsToReturn
methods.description: Binds the collected retry statistics back to a result or exception object.
